task: Closed-schema dispatch packet with exact pickup code, gate, packing symbol and citations; abstain on missing/conflicting evidence
classification: Prospective synthetic task values and fixed deterministic consumer, not open-ended agent QA; six designed scenarios with two populations each, not twelve independent capabilities

assignment.order: control then treatment for each iteration; cases fixed corpus order

judge: Separate full-authorized-input SQLite distinct-value reconciliation; exact canonical packet checksum and per-field source citations

Graphiti.treatment: union with native outbound BFS/RRF depth1 limit8
Graphiti.mapping: literal bodies to EntityNode.summary; directed free labels to EntityEdge; scopes to groups; no extraction

Hindsight.embedding: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 ONNX pinned in prior protocol; CPU1
Hindsight.mapping: literal retain bodies; each unordered edge pair becomes opaque shared entity; scopes to banks; no extraction

limits: Native retrieval budgets, embeddings, transport and storage differ; same task bytes and final consumer bound do not equate native work.
Timings are diagnostics, not causal cross-product speed estimates.
Synthetic JSON fact grammar makes parsing deterministic and does not measure general language understanding.
Task facts are trusted supplied records; this does not test authorization beyond native configured channel/group/bank boundaries.
No model, provider, policy or query settings will change after first result inspection.
